sys_update_xml.payload:
<record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><sys_id>afd1af2ad0b256edbb4952f7cc135f20</sys_id><sys_scope>global</sys_scope><sys_package>global</sys_package><name>LocalLLMVoiceTaskControl</name><api_name>global.LocalLLMVoiceTaskControl</api_name><active>false</active><client_callable>false</client_callable><access>package_private</access><script>/* ES5; prospective owned Global Script Include. No ambient/model authority. */
var LocalLLMVoiceTaskControl = Class.create();
LocalLLMVoiceTaskControl.prototype = {
    initialize: function(repository, policy, business) {
        this.repo = repository;
        this.policy = policy;
        this.business = business;
    },
    _fail: function(code) { throw new Error(code); },
    _id: function(value) {
        if (typeof value !== 'string' || !/^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$/.test(value)) this._fail('invalid_identifier');
        return value;
    },
    _schema: function(value, required) {
        if (!value || Object.prototype.toString.call(value) !== '[object Object]') this._fail('invalid_schema');
        var keys = Object.keys(value).sort();
        if (keys.join('|') !== required.slice().sort().join('|')) this._fail('invalid_schema');
    },
    _canonical: function(value) {
        if (value === null || typeof value !== 'object') return JSON.stringify(value);
        var self = this;
        return '{' + Object.keys(value).sort().map(function(key) { return JSON.stringify(key) + ':' + self._canonical(value[key]); }).join(',') + '}';
    },
    _actor: function(task, write) {
        var a = this.policy.authorize(write);
        if (!a || a.execute!==true || (write && a.write!==true) || typeof a.expires_at!=='number' || !(a.expires_at > this.repo.now())) this._fail('denied');
        var fields = ['principal', 'service', 'agent', 'tool', 'registry_revision'];
        for (var i=0;i<fields.length;i++) {
            this._id(a[fields[i]]);
            if (task && task[fields[i]] !== a[fields[i]]) this._fail('denied');
        }
        if (task && task.expires_at <= this.repo.now()) this._fail('denied');
        return a;
    },
    _binding: function(a) {
        return {principal:a.principal,service:a.service,agent:a.agent,tool:a.tool,registry_revision:a.registry_revision};
    },
    _proposal: function(input) {
        this._schema(input, ['employee_name','start_date','delivery_location','manager_name']);
        var out = {}, names = Object.keys(input);
        for(var i=0;i<names.length;i++) {
            var name=names[i], value=input[name];
            if(typeof value !== 'string' || !value.replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g,'') || value.length>100 || /[\x00-\x1f\x7f]/.test(value)) this._fail('invalid_proposal');
            out[name]=value.replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g,'');
        }
        if(!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(out.start_date)) this._fail('invalid_proposal');
        // Calendar, requester, manager, catalog and cart remain SCC business validation.
        return out;
    },
    create: function(input) {
        this._schema(input,['command_id','objective','context_version']);
        this._id(input.command_id);
        if(typeof input.objective!=='string'||!input.objective||input.objective.length>4000||input.context_version!==1) this._fail('invalid_task');
        var actor=this._actor(null,false), binding=this._binding(actor), hash=this.repo.hash(this._canonical({binding:binding,input:input}));
        var prior=this.repo.get('task','command_id',input.command_id);
        if(prior) {
            this._actor(prior,false);
            if(prior.command_hash!==hash) this._fail('command_conflict');
            return {task_id:prior.id,revision:'root',registry_revision:prior.registry_revision};
        }
        var row=binding;
        row.id=this.repo.id(); row.command_id=input.command_id; row.command_hash=hash;
        row.objective=input.objective;row.context_version=1;row.expires_at=Math.min(actor.expires_at,this.repo.now()+3600000);
        if(!this.repo.insert('task',row)) this._fail('create_conflict');
        return {task_id:row.id,revision:'root',registry_revision:row.registry_revision};
    },
    _task: function(id, write) {
        this._id(id);
        var task=this.repo.get('task','id',id);
        if(!task) this._fail('denied');
        this._actor(task,write);return task;
    },
    _head: function(task) {
        var head={id:'root',kind:'create',version:1,task_id:task.id}, next, count=0;
        while((next=this.repo.get('transition','predecessor_slot',task.id+':'+head.id))) {
            if(next.task_id!==task.id||next.version!==head.version+1||++count>128) this._fail('invalid_chain');
            head=next;
        }
        return head;
    },
    status: function(id) {
        var task=this._task(id,false), head=this._head(task);
        var event=head.id==='root'?null:this.repo.get('event','event_id','transition:'+head.id);
        return {task_id:task.id,revision:head.id,kind:head.kind,version:head.version,registry_revision:task.registry_revision,
            operation:head.kind==='commit'?this.repo.get('operation','operation_key',head.operation_key):null,events:event?[this._publicEvent(event)]:[]};
    },
    _publicEvent: function(event) {
        // Internal row/index keys are not part of the owned observation protocol.
        return {event_id:event.event_id,sequence:event.sequence,task_id:event.task_id,
            operation_id:event.operation_id,context_version:event.context_version,status:event.status,text:event.text};
    },
    operation: function(key) {
        this._id(key);var op=this.repo.get('operation','operation_key',key);
        if(!op) this._fail('denied');this._task(op.task_id,false);return op;
    },
    command: function(id, input) {
        var kinds={amend:['proposal'],prepare:['proposal'],confirm:['proposal_id','utterance_ref'],
            cancel:[],commit:['proposal_id','confirmation_id','operation_key']};
        if(!input || !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(kinds,input.kind)) this._fail('invalid_command');
        this._schema(input,['command_id','expected_revision','kind','context_version'].concat(kinds[input.kind]));
        this._id(input.command_id);this._id(input.expected_revision);
        if(typeof input.context_version!=='number'||input.context_version%1||input.context_version<1||input.context_version>2147483647) this._fail('invalid_command');
        var task=this._task(id,input.kind==='commit'), actor=this._binding(task);
        var fingerprint=this.repo.hash(this._canonical({task_id:id,binding:actor,input:input}));
        var prior=this.repo.get('transition','command_id',input.command_id);
        if(prior) {
            if(prior.task_id!==id||prior.command_hash!==fingerprint) this._fail('command_conflict');
            return this._result(task,prior);
        }
        var head=this._head(task);
        if(head.id!==input.expected_revision) this._fail('revision_conflict');
        if(head.kind==='commit') this._fail('correction_deferred');
        if(head.kind==='cancel') this._fail('task_cancelled');
        if(head.context_version && input.context_version<head.context_version) this._fail('revision_conflict');
        var row={id:this.repo.id(),task_id:id,predecessor_slot:id+':'+head.id,predecessor:head.id,
            command_id:input.command_id,command_hash:fingerprint,kind:input.kind,version:head.version+1,context_version:input.context_version,
            principal:task.principal,service:task.service,agent:task.agent,tool:task.tool,registry_revision:task.registry_revision};
        if(input.kind==='prepare'||input.kind==='amend') {
            row.proposal=this._proposal(input.proposal);row.payload_hash=this.repo.hash(this._canonical(row.proposal));
            row.expires_at=Math.min(task.expires_at,this.repo.now()+300000);
        } else if(input.kind==='confirm') {
            this._id(input.proposal_id);this._id(input.utterance_ref);
            if(head.kind!=='prepare'||head.id!==input.proposal_id||head.expires_at<=this.repo.now()) this._fail('proposal_conflict');
            row.proposal_id=head.id;row.proposal=head.proposal;row.payload_hash=head.payload_hash;
            row.expires_at=head.expires_at;row.utterance_ref=input.utterance_ref;
        } else if(input.kind==='commit') {
            this._id(input.proposal_id);this._id(input.confirmation_id);this._id(input.operation_key);
            if(head.kind!=='confirm'||head.id!==input.confirmation_id||head.proposal_id!==input.proposal_id||head.expires_at<=this.repo.now()) this._fail('confirmation_conflict');
            if(this.repo.get('operation','operation_key',input.operation_key)) this._fail('operation_conflict');
            row.operation_key=input.operation_key;row.proposal_id=head.proposal_id;row.confirmation_id=head.id;
            row.proposal=head.proposal;row.payload_hash=head.payload_hash;row.expires_at=head.expires_at;
        }
        var inserted=this.repo.insert('transition',row);
        if(!inserted) {
            var winner=this.repo.get('transition','predecessor_slot',row.predecessor_slot);
            if(!winner||winner.command_id!==row.command_id||winner.command_hash!==row.command_hash) this._fail('revision_conflict');
            row=winner;
        }
        return this._result(task,row);
    },
    _result: function(task,row) {
        var result={task_id:task.id,command_id:row.command_id,revision:row.id,kind:row.kind,version:row.version};
        if(row.proposal) {result.proposal=row.proposal;result.payload_hash=row.payload_hash;result.expires_at=row.expires_at;}
        if(row.kind==='commit') result.operation=new LocalLLMVoiceOrderGuard(this.repo,this.policy,this.business).dispatch(task,row);
        var eventId='transition:'+row.id;
        if(!this.repo.get('event','event_id',eventId)) {
            var event={id:this.repo.id(),event_id:eventId,sequence:row.version,task_sequence:task.id+':'+row.version,
                task_id:task.id,operation_id:row.operation_key||row.command_id,context_version:row.context_version,
                status:row.kind==='commit'?'submitted':(row.kind==='cancel'?'cancelled':'awaiting_input'),text:''};
            if(!this.repo.insert('event',event) && !this.repo.get('event','event_id',eventId)) this._fail('event_unavailable');
        }
        return result;
    },
    type:'LocalLLMVoiceTaskControl'
};
</script><description>Inactive prospective authority package; qualification required before any activation.</description></sys_script_include></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><sys_id>858d8020e7b75404acf421906ea0e8dc</sys_id><sys_scope>global</sys_scope><sys_package>global</sys_package><name>LocalLLMVoiceOrderGuard</name><api_name>global.LocalLLMVoiceOrderGuard</api_name><active>false</active><client_callable>false</client_callable><access>package_private</access><script>/* Separate durable claim; no lease expiry, reclaim, or arbitrary tool lookup. */
var LocalLLMVoiceOrderGuard = Class.create();
LocalLLMVoiceOrderGuard.prototype = {
    initialize:function(repository,policy,business) {this.repo=repository;this.policy=policy;this.business=business;},
    dispatch:function(task,fence) {
        var control=new LocalLLMVoiceTaskControl(this.repo,this.policy,this.business);
        task=control._task(task.id,true);
        var stored=this.repo.get('transition','id',fence.id);
        if(!stored||stored.kind!=='commit'||stored.task_id!==task.id||stored.command_hash!==fence.command_hash) throw new Error('fence_denied');
        fence=stored;
        var key=fence.operation_key, op=this.repo.get('operation','operation_key',key);
        if(!op) {
            op={id:this.repo.id(),operation_key:key,task_id:task.id,principal:task.principal,
                service:task.service,agent:task.agent,tool:task.tool,registry_revision:task.registry_revision,
                fence_id:fence.id,proposal_id:fence.proposal_id,confirmation_id:fence.confirmation_id,
                payload_hash:fence.payload_hash,proposal:fence.proposal,context_version:fence.context_version,state:'outcome_unknown'};
            if(!this.repo.insert('operation',op)) op=this.repo.get('operation','operation_key',key);
        }
        if(!op||op.task_id!==task.id||op.fence_id!==fence.id||op.payload_hash!==fence.payload_hash) throw new Error('operation_conflict');
        if(op.receipt) return op;
        // The production policy remains hard denied until a separate transaction
        // durably commits this claim BEFORE CartJS. Source tests cannot prove that.
        var claim={id:this.repo.id(),operation_key:key,operation_id:op.id,task_id:task.id,claimed_at:this.repo.now()};
        if(!this.repo.insert('claim',claim)) return this.repo.get('operation','operation_key',key);
        control._actor(task,true);
        try {
            var input={confirmed:'true',employee_name:op.proposal.employee_name,start_date:op.proposal.start_date,
                delivery_location:op.proposal.delivery_location,manager_name:op.proposal.manager_name};
            var result=this.business.submit(input);
            if(result&&result.ok===true&&result.request_id&&result.requested_item_id) {
                control._id(String(result.request_id));control._id(String(result.requested_item_id));
                return this.repo.receipt(key,{state:'succeeded',request_ref:String(result.request_id),execution_ref:String(result.requested_item_id)});
            }
            if(result&&result.request_id) {
                control._id(String(result.request_id));
                return this.repo.receipt(key,{state:'outcome_unknown',request_ref:String(result.request_id)});
            }
            // A business failure message can follow an actual side effect. Do not
            // infer no order or retry permission from ok:false or missing RITM.
        } catch(ignored) {}
        return this.repo.get('operation','operation_key',key);
    },
    type:'LocalLLMVoiceOrderGuard'
};
</script><description>Inactive prospective authority package; qualification required before any activation.</description></sys_script_include></record_update>

<record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><sys_id>bb63ddcb6fa25697a488119450a78765</sys_id><sys_scope>global</sys_scope><sys_package>global</sys_package><name>LocalLLMVoiceRepository</name><api_name>global.LocalLLMVoiceRepository</api_name><active>false</active><client_callable>false</client_callable><access>package_private</access><script>/* Fixed owned tables only. Direct table ACLs deny callers; server code owns writes. */
var LocalLLMVoiceRepository = Class.create();
LocalLLMVoiceRepository.prototype = {
    initialize:function() {
        this.tables={task:'u_scc_voice_task',transition:'u_scc_voice_transition',operation:'u_scc_voice_operation',
            claim:'u_scc_voice_dispatch_claim',event:'u_scc_voice_event'};
        this.columns={id:'u_key',command_id:'u_command_key',predecessor_slot:'u_predecessor_slot',
            operation_key:'u_operation_key',task_id:'u_task_key',event_id:'u_source_event_key',task_sequence:'u_task_sequence',
            service:'u_service',agent:'u_agent',tool:'u_tool',registry_revision:'u_registry_revision',
            payload_hash:'u_payload_hash',proposal_id:'u_proposal_key',confirmation_id:'u_confirmation_key'};
    },
    id:function() {return String(gs.generateGUID());},
    now:function() {return new GlideDateTime().getNumericValue()*1;},
    hash:function(text) {return String(new GlideDigest().getSHA256Hex(text));},
    _record:function(table) {
        if(!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(this.tables,table)) throw new Error('invalid_table');
        var record=new GlideRecord(this.tables[table]);
        if(!record.isValid()) throw new Error('schema_unavailable');
        return record;
    },
    _find:function(table,field,value) {
        if(!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(this.columns,field)) throw new Error('invalid_field');
        var gr=this._record(table), column=this.columns[field];
        if(!gr.isValidField(column)) throw new Error('schema_unavailable');
        gr.addQuery(column,value);gr.setLimit(2);gr.query();return gr;
    },
    get:function(table,field,value) {
        var gr=this._find(table,field,value);
        if(!gr.next()) return null;
        var data=JSON.parse(String(gr.getValue('u_data')));
        if(gr.next()) throw new Error('unique_index_unavailable');
        if(table==='operation') {
            var receipt=this.get('event','event_id','receipt:'+data.operation_key);
            if(receipt) {data.receipt=receipt.receipt;data.state=receipt.receipt.state;}
        }
        return data;
    },
    insert:function(table,row) {
        var gr=this._record(table);gr.initialize();
        var fields=Object.keys(this.columns);
        for(var i=0;i<fields.length;i++) if(row[fields[i]]!==undefined && gr.isValidField(this.columns[fields[i]])) gr.setValue(this.columns[fields[i]],row[fields[i]]);
        gr.setValue('u_data',JSON.stringify(row));
        if(row.principal) gr.setValue('u_owner',row.principal);
        if(row.task_id) {
            var task=this._find('task','id',row.task_id);
            if(!task.next()) throw new Error('task_reference_unavailable');
            gr.setValue('u_task',task.getUniqueValue());
        }
        if(table==='claim') {
            var operation=this._find('operation','id',row.operation_id);
            if(!operation.next()) throw new Error('operation_reference_unavailable');
            gr.setValue('u_operation',operation.getUniqueValue());
        }
        try {if(!gr.insert()) return null;} catch(ignored) {return null;}
        return row;
    },
    receipt:function(key,receipt) {
        // Receipt is an append-only event, avoiding concurrent mutable result updates.
        var op=this.get('operation','operation_key',key);
        if(!op) throw new Error('operation_unavailable');
        var eventKey='receipt:'+key, existing=this.get('event','event_id',eventKey);
        if(existing && JSON.stringify(existing.receipt)!==JSON.stringify(receipt)) throw new Error('receipt_conflict');
        if(!existing) {
            var row={id:this.id(),event_id:eventKey,task_id:op.task_id,task_sequence:op.task_id+':receipt:'+key,
                operation_key:key,receipt:receipt};
            if(!this.insert('event',row)) {
                existing=this.get('event','event_id',eventKey);
                if(!existing || JSON.stringify(existing.receipt)!==JSON.stringify(receipt)) throw new Error('receipt_conflict');
            }
        }
        op.receipt=receipt;op.state=receipt.state;return op;
    },
    type:'LocalLLMVoiceRepository'
};
</script><description>Inactive prospective authority package; qualification required before any activation.</description></sys_script_include></record_update>

<record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><sys_id>89ccc0df357e5cdaaf3cc676895ee3cc</sys_id><sys_scope>global</sys_scope><sys_package>global</sys_package><name>LocalLLMVoicePlatform</name><api_name>global.LocalLLMVoicePlatform</api_name><active>false</active><client_callable>false</client_callable><access>package_private</access><script>/* Deployment boundary: no property, manifest hash, or Boolean enables authority. */
var LocalLLMVoicePlatform = Class.create();
LocalLLMVoicePlatform.prototype = {
    initialize:function() {},
    registry:function() {
        if(!gs.getUserID() || gs.getUserName()==='guest') throw new Error('denied');
        return {protocol_version:2,package_revision:'responsive-tasks-v2-candidate-1',capability_revision:null,
            principal:null,service_id:null,agents:[],capabilities:{safe_write:false,independent_context:false,
                checkpoints:false,status_lookup:false,durable_execution:false,authoritative_idempotency:false,version_fence:false},
            evidence:{source:'owned_package',qualification:'unqualified',missing:[
                'platform_principal_service_agent_tool_binding','responsive_unguarded_tool_removal',
                'unique_index_and_transaction_qualification','claim_durable_before_side_effect',
